# ThriveTools.co

> ThriveTools.co is a science-backed wellness and biohacking platform by Eden Laraki, built from 14 years of personal research. The site's core is verified discount codes for 40+ vetted wellness brands (supplements, longevity tech, red light therapy, EMF protection, non-toxic home), head-to-head product comparisons, brand guides, and science-backed articles. Every discount code is checked and updated monthly.
